definitions.explanation: A pricing method where the displayed price already includes consumption tax.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}は{内税|うちぜい}です。
{内税|うちぜい}{表示|ひょうじ}なので{分|わ}かりやすい。
examples.english: The tax-inclusive display makes it easy to understand.

examples.japanese: このお{店|みせ}は{内税|うちぜい}と{外税|そとぜい}が{混在|こんざい}している。
examples.english: This store has both tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive prices.

notes:
CONTRAST:
- {内税|うちぜい}: tax-inclusive (displayed price includes tax)
- {外税|そとぜい}: tax-exclusive (tax added at checkout)

SYNONYM:
- {税込|ぜいこ}み: tax-included (more common expression)

JAPAN NOTE:
Since 2021, Japan requires businesses to display tax-inclusive prices ({総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}) as the main price.
